ownership: Product problem, users, journeys, scope, requirements, and objective success evidence.
exclusions: Architecture, program layout, implementation tickets, and source-code changes.
verification: Trace every requirement to the PRD and expose unresolved product decisions.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the Product Review artifact, its revision, verification summary, and unresolved risks.

ownership: Component ownership, contracts, data models, architectural decisions, constraints, and risks.
exclusions: Product-scope changes, low-level implementation, and Ticket assignment.
verification: Give every approved requirement an owning component and explicit contract coverage.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the architecture artifact, input revisions, policy hashes, and open risks.

ownership: Modules, paths, types, signatures, call flows, errors, and test seams.
exclusions: Product-scope changes, architecture replacement, Ticket assignment, and implementation.
verification: Map design elements to approved requirements and architecture contracts.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the program-design artifact, input revisions, policy hashes, and open risks.

ownership: Small end-to-end Tickets, dependencies, file ownership, and required evidence.
exclusions: Changing approved product intent or upstream technical contracts.
verification: Cover every applicable requirement and design element without cycles or unsafe parallel ownership.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the slice artifact, dependency map, input revisions, and unresolved risks.

ownership: Independent, deterministic Acceptance Tests derived from the Ticket criteria.
exclusions: Production implementation, existing-test modification, and scope changes.
verification: Cover automatable criteria, boundary behavior, and user-visible failure cases.
handoff_receipt: Hand off protected test paths and hashes, test intent, and unresolved evidence gaps.

ownership: Production code and implementation-owned tests within the assigned Ticket scope.
exclusions: Protected Acceptance Tests, unrelated files, lifecycle state, and approved scope.
verification: Run required gates and preserve the hashes of QA-owned Acceptance Tests.
handoff_receipt: Hand off changed files, commits, gate evidence, claimed result, and unresolved risks.

ownership: Readability and maintainability improvements within the implemented Ticket diff.
exclusions: Behavior changes, protected Acceptance Tests, and unrelated cleanup.
verification: Preserve behavior and run the required gates after cleanup.
handoff_receipt: Hand off cleanup changes, verification, and any remaining maintainability risk.

ownership: Read-only comparison of the implementation with approved architecture contracts.
exclusions: All file modifications, including protected Acceptance Tests.
verification: Report contract conformance or block with precise deviations.
handoff_receipt: Hand off a read-only conformance claim, evidence references, and unresolved deviations.

ownership: Ticket-scoped reliability, error handling, and security improvements justified by identified risk.
exclusions: Protected Acceptance Tests, unrelated hardening, and product-scope expansion.
verification: Run required gates and document the risk addressed by each change.
handoff_receipt: Hand off hardening changes, verification, and residual risk.

ownership: Execution of configured required and advisory verification gates.
exclusions: Source changes, test weakening, and lifecycle decisions outside gate results.
verification: Record command, exit status, bounded output, duration, and required/advisory status.
handoff_receipt: Hand off gate results and any blocking or advisory failures.

ownership: Read-only final assessment of requirements, policy, protected evidence, and gate results.
exclusions: All file modifications and acceptance of unresolved blocking risk.
verification: Block when the claimed result is not supported by objective evidence.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the final read-only verdict, evidence references, and unresolved risks.

ownership: Human decision to merge, request changes, or stop based on the complete evidence.
exclusions: Automatic approval and silent waiver of blocking evidence.
verification: Inspect scope, protected evidence, gates, receipts, and unresolved risks.
handoff_receipt: Hand off the review state and stable GitHub or local merge reference.
